why: SA5011's remaining entry here is the *missing* one (sa5011/ok/ok.go:89) — upstream reports it and guff does not; the two sigma directions guff now models (`sigma_shadows`, and `renamed_before_check` added 2026-08-13, which closed both consul allowlist entries) are about *not* reporting; SA6001 recall; SA4015/SA4031/SA5005/SA9004 precision. The Go stdlib error text that used to head this list is gone: SA1000, SA1001, SA1002 and SA1007 are all ports now, in crates/guff-staticcheck/src/gostd/. SA1011's recall is gone from this list too (missing 9 -> 7, 2026-08-10): it asked whether a constant was valid UTF-8 while the constant layer held it as Rust text, so the answer was always yes. SA9008's pattern matches upstream exactly; what remains there is its IR verification (docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4, 2026-08-09). SA1019 left this list on 2026-08-12 (missing 7 -> 5, extra 9 -> 7): it reported at the selected name instead of the start of the selector (upstream hands `report.Report` the whole `*ast.SelectorExpr`), and the deprecation message was trimmed while upstream's `strings.Replace(alt, "\\n", " ", -1)` leaves the trailing space that `doc.Text()` puts there. SA4006's interface-boxing extra left this list on 2026-08-13 (extra 7 -> 6): guff-ssa's `MakeInterface` now carries the boxed value, so `i = n` into an `interface{}` gives `n` a referrer. SA1023 and SA4020 left this list on 2026-08-14 (missing 5 -> 3, extra 6 -> 4): SA1023 reported at the function name and once per function, where upstream reports the modifying *instruction* — the assignment, or the `append` call itself — once each; SA4020 spelled the empty-interface case "earlier case" instead of naming the type as written (`any` vs `interface{}`). Both measured against golangci-lint 2.12.2. 2026-08-14, second pass: SA4015 was inverted — its IR arm matched `ChangeType` where upstream matches `ir.Convert`, so it had zero recall, and the AST fallback standing in for it fired on `math.Ceil(1)`, which upstream never reports (the constant is already float64, there is no conversion). Rewritten to the IR arm alone; 7 shapes now match golangci-lint 2.12.2 exactly. SA9004 reported at the group's type expression instead of `group[0].Pos()`, i.e. the first name. The two survivors are SA4031 and SA5005, and both are inverted the same way as SA4015 was: measured on 2026-08-14, upstream reports 5 shapes of SA4031 (make/new/slice-literal/func-value/address-of, with related information naming the variable) and guff reports none of them while reporting an inline `make(chan int) == nil` upstream ignores; upstream reports SA5005 on *nothing*, including the textbook `runtime.SetFinalizer(x, func(_ *int){ _ = x })`, while guff reports it. Both need a real port, not a tweak.
target: 0/0 — see docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4 (2026-08-09) for the remaining classes.
